boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Lipscomb places for studying, gathering, recreation, performances and campus events, each supported by a direct university source.

cards.title: Bison Square
cards.subtitle: Central outdoor gathering space
cards.notes: Bring a study guide or meet a classmate outside; Lipscomb identifies the square as a setting for campus events and studying.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus setting for events, conversation and study breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says students use Bison Square for campus events and studying for tests.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted event and campus-access guidance.

cards.title: Bennett Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Dining, seating and Student Life hub
cards.notes: Use the open seating, TV areas or conference rooms between classes; check the building for current room and event availability.
cards.short_summary: A shared indoor hub with food, seating, meeting rooms and Student Life offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says Bennett Campus Center includes dining, Starbucks, The Connection, TV areas, conference rooms and Student Life offices.
cards.access_notes: Amenities and rooms may have separate hours or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Beaman Library
cards.subtitle: Library study rooms and research help
cards.notes: Reserve a study room for a group of up to four, or schedule research help when an assignment needs stronger sources.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with reservable rooms, research assistance and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Beaman Library offers study-room reservations for up to four people and research appointments with librarians.
cards.access_notes: Lipscomb describes it as a private university library; carry a valid Lipscomb ID if requested.

cards.title: Coggin Family Academic Success Center
cards.subtitle: Academic support in Beaman Library
cards.notes: Book tutoring, writing-studio or advising support when you need a focused academic work session instead of studying alone.
cards.short_summary: A coordinated campus resource for tutoring, writing support and academic advising.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb lists peer tutoring, a math lab, writing studio and advising among Academic Success Center support services.
cards.access_notes: Confirm appointments and service availability through the Learning Commons.

cards.title: Student Activities Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation and fitness facility
cards.notes: Plan a workout, indoor-track walk or court session; reserve facilities in advance when an activity, practice or event requires it.
cards.short_summary: A recreation facility with fitness, courts, studios, track and locker rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says the SAC has weight rooms, basketball and racquetball courts, studios, an indoor track and locker rooms.
cards.access_notes: Students receive a free membership; some facilities require an approved reservation.

cards.title: Flatt Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Outdoor performance space by Bennett
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for an outdoor concert, debate or performance, then arrive with time to find seating near Bennett.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor venue used for campus performances and special events.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb identifies Flatt Amphitheater as a home for performances, meetings, debates and other special events.
cards.access_notes: Event attendance, seating and ticket policies vary by program.

cards.title: Shamblin Theatre
cards.subtitle: Campus performance and event venue
cards.notes: Look for a performance, debate, meeting or special event listing; use the schedule to confirm whether the program is open to you.
cards.short_summary: An indoor campus venue for performances, meetings, debates and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb identifies Shamblin Theatre as a home for performances, meetings, debates and other special events.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on the scheduled program and its event policies.

cards.title: Allen Arena
cards.subtitle: Bison athletics and weekly Chapel venue
cards.notes: Check the athletics or campus calendar for basketball, volleyball or Chapel programming before making plans to attend.
cards.short_summary: A major campus gathering venue for NCAA competition and weekly Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says Allen Arena hosts NCAA Division I basketball and volleyball and brings campus together for weekly Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Game and event admission policies vary; verify details with the relevant schedule.

cards.title: Allen Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Carillon landmark and outdoor gathering point
cards.notes: Pause on the steps between classes or watch for outdoor programming; the carillon marks time and is used for special occasions.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark whose bells and steps frame everyday and ceremonial moments.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says the tower chimes hourly, is used for special occasions and is a central community gathering point where students study on its steps.
cards.source_title: Allen Bell Tower, King part of the fabric of campus community for 25 years
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; respect any event setup or campus safety instructions.

cards.title: Student Innovation House
cards.subtitle: 3711 Mayfair Avenue, across from campus
cards.notes: Take a project team to its collaborative workspaces or conference room, and ask the entrepreneurship center about available tools.
cards.short_summary: A student creative workspace with collaboration areas and prototyping equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says the Student Innovation House is open to all students and provides collaborative workspaces, a conference room and prototyping tools.
cards.access_notes: Located across from campus; contact the Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation about access and equipment use.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Lipscomb University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend route: get oriented, find practical campus anchors, eat, move, and check the student-events calendar.

cards.title: Start with a campus landmark
cards.subtitle: Bison Statue · main campus
cards.notes: Use the statue as a simple first meetup point, then open the campus map and choose one nearby building to identify before moving on.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark for beginning the walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s current campus map lists the Bison Statue as a named destination.
cards.access_notes: Located on Lipscomb’s Nashville campus; consult the current campus map for routing.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Bison Square
cards.subtitle: Bison Square & Osman Fountain · main campus
cards.notes: Pause in the square to orient yourself to the central campus area, then use it as a recognizable return point for the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A central named outdoor campus gathering point.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb identifies Bison Square & Osman Fountain on its current campus map, and its visit page describes Bison Square as a place for events, studying, and relaxing outside.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Locate your library base
cards.subtitle: Beaman Library · main campus
cards.notes: Walk through Beaman Library and note the security office location or study resources that may help once classes and campus routines begin.
cards.short_summary: A named library destination and campus resource anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s campus map lists Beaman Library, and the university’s ID-card page identifies it as the location of the Security and Safety office.
cards.access_notes: Building access may depend on your Lipscomb ID and campus policies.

cards.title: Check the gallery calendar
cards.subtitle: Hutcheson Art Gallery · Beaman Library
cards.notes: When an exhibition is scheduled, add the gallery to an afternoon campus loop and check the event listing for the show’s specific admission details.
cards.short_summary: A named art-gallery destination inside Beaman Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s event listing locates Hutcheson Art Gallery in Beaman Library and documents exhibitions there.
cards.source_title: Shane and Mattie Ree Neal Art Exhibit Opening
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and access vary; verify the individual event page before visiting.

cards.title: Find the campus-services hub
cards.subtitle: Bennett Campus Center · main campus
cards.notes: Make a quick pass through Bennett to identify the food court, Bison Café, bookstore, lockers, and post-office services for future errands.
cards.short_summary: A named campus center with dining and everyday services.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb’s current campus map lists Bennett Campus Center and identifies dining, the University Bookstore, Amazon Lockers, and the Post Office there.
cards.access_notes: Campus building; individual services have their own availability and payment requirements.

cards.title: Plan one easy campus meal
cards.subtitle: Bison Café · Bennett Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the dining page to check menus and hours, then choose Bison Café when you want a cafeteria-style breakfast, lunch, or dinner on campus.
cards.short_summary: A cafeteria-style dining stop in Bennett Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb states that Bison Café is in Bennett Campus Center, serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and offers freshly prepared food selections.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by the school-year calendar; food requires a meal plan, Dining Dollars, Lipscomb Bucks, cash, or card as applicable.

cards.title: Find the Student Activities Center
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Center · main campus
cards.notes: Stop by the SAC to see where recreation happens and to locate Freshens, which has café-style seating and outdoor dining space.
cards.short_summary: A named recreation and dining destination on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb identifies the Student Activities Center on its campus map and states that Freshens there offers café-style seating and al fresco dining.
cards.access_notes: Campus recreation spaces and dining options may require student credentials or payment.

cards.title: Try a recreation option
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation · Student Activities Center
cards.notes: Browse the recreation schedule or app, then choose a gym visit, group-fitness class, hike resource, or other listed activity that fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: University-run recreation programming and facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb Campus Recreation runs the Student Activities Center, group fitness classes, intramurals, and outdoor-adventure resources.
cards.access_notes: Use the recreation portal or app for schedules, signups, occupancy, and any required credentials.

cards.title: See what intramurals are running
cards.subtitle: Lipscomb Intramurals · Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Check current signups before committing; intramurals provide a structured way to meet people while choosing an activity that matches your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: A university-operated recreational sports activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb states that Campus Recreation runs Lipscomb Intramurals and that its portal supports signing up for intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: Registration and facility use are managed through Campus Recreation; confirm current offerings and requirements first.

cards.title: End by checking the SAB calendar
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Board · student programming
cards.notes: Look for an upcoming inclusive event and invite a hallmate or classmate; verify the event’s time, location, and any registration details before going.
cards.short_summary: Student-led social programming on and off campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Lipscomb says its Student Activities Board plans and hosts inclusive social opportunities, including trivia and game nights, food trucks, dances, and other events.
cards.access_notes: Events vary by date; consult the event calendar or Student Activities Board for current details.
